body:
T+0.00: ~30 mg DMT
T+0.15: ~20 mg 10x Salvia
T+0.25: 40 mg 10x Salvia
Age: 18
Weight: 128 lbs
Gender: Male
Prior substance use: Marijuana, Alcohol, Kratom, Nitrous, Shrooms, DMT, Hydrocodone. One old 7.5/750 Vicodin taken the night before with little effect. .
I was bringing 80 mg DMT loaded in the Machine, a gram of 10x Salvia extract and some weed over to my friends house. I wanted to do a bit of Salvia as a test or breakthrough on DMT tonight; I didnt really care about the weed. We decided it would be the DMT.
T+0.00 (12:10): Started slowly smoking the DMT. Ive been trying to breakthrough for a while but havent gotten the hang of it, therefore the large amount of DMT in the pipe. Using a broken heat gun converted into a torch lighter made it no easier for me. Slowly I hit it, allowing no smoke to appear. However it was too slow and I realized I wasnt going to breakthrough.
T+0.05: Finished smoking it, figured it was around equivalent to around 25 mg when I was at my best at smoking it. Torch lighter or not, I need to be more aggressive. Little visual shifting but nothing much, could still talk and control myself.
T+0.15: Still feeling the mildly euphoric DMT aftermath, I decided since I didnt break through on DMT I was going to try around 50 mg of Salvia. I had never done it before and wanted to try it before I did it with my relatively drug naïve friends. I weighed it out and put it in a regular glass pipe. The smoke was significantly harsher than expected, perhaps since I hadnt actually smoked any plant material in nearly a month. So I cherry bombed it and spent a frenzied 20 sec putting the embers out. Continuing onward and holding my breath the edge of my vision began to move. I released my breath and focused on my friends as they looked at me. My field of vision split in with a region of space being separated from the rest. My itchy shirt really began to bug me. The overall experience was a great mindfuck with few colorful visuals. Overall relatively positive.
T+0.25: So relatively down from that, I loaded 40 mg of Salvia in the same pipe. I promised not to cherry bomb and went on my way. This time I cleared almost the entire pipe, leaving perhaps 3 mg left. Not that it matters. So held on for a while and vision started moving again. This time the world was cleaved in three as I fell upon the couch. There existed three identical worlds that all mirrored each other to form a kaleidoscope of the world I was looking at. I existed in the middle, for I was the couch I was sitting on, and was incredibly intrigued by the sensation.
T+0.30: At this time I thought I talked to one of my friends so after I was down I asked him if I did. He told me I called one of my friends over and inquired, I just smoked Salvia right?
Yea, he replied
This is so interesting, and, this is so weird, were the two things I said to him over and over again.
T+0.40: I slowly came down and one field of vision became prominent while I realized I was no longer part of the couch that I was earlier. The overall experience was lacking in euphoria and hard to remember. The lingering Salvia feelings were slightly overpowered by the lingering DMT feelings and relatively uninteresting, although they seriously messed up my coordination.
Now I know that 100 mg of Salvia for a first-time-for-anything-but-weed might be a bit much for my friends. I felt like I learned something profound yet it was hard to really remember much.
